counterexample_to_an_inference.claim_refuted: Singleton Zpt, empty Zc, generic punctured sides and a critical sign change imply injective center vertices for all n>=3.
reasoning: All coordinates are continuous. The ordered determinant det(mu1-mu0,mu2-mu0)=t, so for every t!=0 all distinct-triple determinants are nonzero and their critical sign changes.
For t!=0 the three edges form a nondegenerate triangle. Any two adjacent edge interiors are disjoint because their supporting lines meet only at the shared endpoint; hence G2 holds.
At t=0, mu0=mu1. The unique unordered triple of three distinct labels has determinant zero, so Zpt is the singleton consisting of all three labels.
Every edge pair of a 3-cycle is adjacent, so no triple of pairwise remote edges exists and Zc is empty.
Two central geometric points coincide, making a representation with all three xi distinct and a nonzero common direction impossible.
